_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil persists: no breaker is present (Fed liquidity at 0, ETF flows weak, VIX crushed, DVOL at 28th percentile), and the 0% base rate of ±2+ moves across 72 windows makes HOLD the only statistically defensible call.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both identify a sideways coil in Denial, but split on interpretation: Analyst sees compression without directional resolution while Narrative frames it as a bottoming foundation.
next_move.confirmed_if: HOLD — score remains within the Denial band (32-38) over the next 12h window
next_move.invalidated_if: LONG or SHORT — score breaks above 39 (Disbelief) or below 31 (Panic), or a named breaker triggers (Fed liquidity >20 + ETF flows >45 for UP; VIX >75 + funding <35 for DOWN)
